title: Linkage between the protocols for EPS mobility management and EPS session management

entities.name: EPS Attach Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE registration with the network, which can include default EPS bearer context activation.

entities.name: Default EPS Bearer Context Activation Procedure
entities.description: Procedure to establish a default EPS bearer context, potentially transmitted within EPS mobility management messages during attach.

entities.name: Dedicated EPS Bearer Context Activation Procedure
entities.description: Procedure to establish one or several dedicated EPS bearer contexts for PDN connections of IP or Ethernet type.

entities.name: Service Request Procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE for transport of user data via control plane, especially in EMM-IDLE mode.

entities.name: CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST Message
entities.description: Message used in service request procedure for control plane CIoT EPS optimization, which can contain ESM DATA TRANSPORT message.

entities.name: ESM DATA TRANSPORT Message
entities.description: ESM message transmitted within CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message for user data transport via control plane.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: EPS Mobility Management state indicating UE is registered with the network.

entities.name: EMM-IDLE
entities.description: EPS Mobility Management state where UE is not actively communicating but registered.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection
entities.description: Condition where UE is registered but has no PDN connection, which may not be supported by UE or MME.

entities.name: Suspend ESM message transmission
entities.description: Behavior where UE or MME suspends transmission of ESM messages during certain EMM procedures.

relations.description: Default EPS bearer context activation can be performed as part of the attach procedure.
Dedicated EPS bearer context activation can be performed in parallel during attach procedure.
Attach procedure completion is dependent on default EPS bearer activation if EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection is not supported.
Condition that attach success depends on default bearer activation if EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection is not supported.
CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message contains ESM DATA TRANSPORT message as an information element.
Service request procedure involves transmission of CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message.
Service request procedure can be initiated by UE in EMM-IDLE mode for control plane data transport.
ESM message transmission is not suspended during attach procedure.
ESM message transmission is not suspended during service request procedure for control plane data transport.
